title: Nuevo Laredo Puts 32 Million Pesos Behind Teachers With ‘Apoyo al Docente’ Bonus
excerpt: Nuevo Laredo is putting about 32 million pesos into its ‘Apoyo al Docente’ program, a bonus for teachers meant to offset the higher cost of living on the border, in a move recognized by Tamaulipas education secretary Miguel Ángel Valdez.
content:
The government of Nuevo Laredo is putting about 32 million pesos into its ‘Apoyo al Docente’ program, a bonus for teachers meant to offset the high cost of living on the border, in a move publicly recognized by Tamaulipas education secretary Miguel Ángel Valdez.

Valdez praised Mayor Carmen Lilia Canturosas Villarreal for standing behind the city’s teachers, calling her a great ally of education in the state. He said the municipal support helps teachers who live on the border, where life costs more, and noted that teachers thanked the mayor for the help.

The bonus is aimed at protecting teachers’ purchasing power and keeping them in their posts. Valdez pointed to four areas where the city supports education: social support, scholarships, infrastructure, and help complementing school resources.

The recognition came as the mayor’s administration continues to pair direct support for educators with school improvements across the city, including work at the CBTIS 137 and 234 campuses.

Sources: Noreste Digital, Nov. 24, 2026; CML Noticias, Nov. 23, 2026.
